parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom structural part of the storage cabinet, made of plywood for stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure and bears the load of stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of MDF, located at the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to store small items and can be pulled out or pushed in using the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along metal or wooden rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the lower storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the internal storage space and protects contents from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports the door, drawer, and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move during use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on design.
